title: fix(oc-path): preserve untouched Markdown during edits
body:
Fixes #172123

## What Problem This Solves

Editing a Markdown body with `openclaw path set` can silently discard unrelated multiline descriptions, nested metadata, and comments while reporting success. Frontmatter edits also re-render the body and change its bytes.

## User Impact

Body edits and item/section insertions retain the original frontmatter. Frontmatter edits and insertions retain the body. Untouched source keeps its comments, quoting, key order, blank lines, BOM, LF/CRLF, and final-newline convention. No migration or configuration change is required. Markdown frontmatter remains `---`-delimited; `+++` remains ordinary body text.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace the lossy whole-file Markdown renderer with source-range edits, using shared line offsets and newline selection extracted from the JSONL preservation fix in #172410. The existing YAML parser identifies the selected frontmatter value's extent without serializing unrelated metadata or removing anchors still referenced by aliases. Preserve the in-memory addressing index across edits: reparsing a literal multiline value as Markdown would create unintended addressable items.

Original fix by @fhgffy; maintainer cleanup completes preservation in both directions, removes the renderer and source-cache invalidation path, strengthens complete-file regressions, and incorporates the merged JSONL and quoted-positional-key repairs.

## Evidence

- Current-main defect confirmed by source/history at `9b2bc0ed7e135d7be69f7f9749684bf30032981c`: the parser's addressing index omits YAML continuation lines/comments, while `rebuildMdRaw` reconstructs all frontmatter and body from that index.
- PR CI is the test and typecheck gate per maintainer policy. It covers the registered CLI/file-I/O regressions, Markdown editing/insertion siblings, shared JSONL behavior, and repository checks. **Passed** [CI run 38709776092](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38709776092) on exact head `8ef8f466cabc3851e74afc99b85ef55378180124`: 24 successful jobs, no failures, and required `openclaw/ci-gate` checks green. Production/test typechecks, affected-extension lint, docs, boundaries, baseline ratchets, and selected runtime tests all passed. Fresh main was merged immediately before pushing, with all reviewed files unchanged.
- [Runtime evidence](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38709776092/job/116338602476): **230 tests passed across 22 oc-path files**, including Markdown, JSONL and registered CLI/file-I/O coverage. The runner reported **13.07 s**; the job took **1m 52s** including setup. All **16** new preservation cases passed in **7–29 ms each, 187 ms combined**.
- Regression: `preserves unrelated Markdown bytes during %s` covers body field edit, item insertion, section insertion, frontmatter edit/insertion, empty anchored values, block-scalar replacement, and nested-metadata replacement with CLI readback; each uses LF with a final newline and CRLF without one. Existing `keeps item positions and explicit values through multiline edits and insertion` now crosses frontmatter line-count changes. `preserves output and input AST when inserting a %s` adds absent/empty-frontmatter cases with BOM.
- Local static lint passed on changed TypeScript files using the installed oxlint and the current core rules. The nested checkout lacks its own install and the inherited dependencies lack the UI-only Solid lint plugin, so the external lint config omits only that inapplicable UI override. Pinned oxfmt 0.72.0 passed through the native precommit hook using the existing tooling owner; `git diff --check` passed. No dependency installation was performed.
- Deslop removed the superseded renderer and contributor `frontmatterRaw` invalidation path. Precommit Codex autoreview found the contributor index version’s frontmatter-loss path (removed by this rewrite) and a stale CRLF diff expectation (corrected to preview an actual value change). A subsequent P2 anchor-preservation finding was fixed by retaining the selected node’s anchor while replacing its string content; the existing byte-preservation fixture now includes an anchor/alias pair. Final committed-branch Codex autoreview: **scoped-clean**, no accepted/actionable P0–P2 findings (exit 0).
- Live Gateway, Crabbox/Testbox, local tests, local typechecks, and negative-control execution were intentionally skipped per maintainer policy. No leases or Gateway processes were started. No local test timing or negative-control result is claimed; the CI timings above are the measured proof.
- ClawSweeper comment 6168475871 reported no code findings. Its shipped-CLI/upgrade proof-only requests are superseded by the explicit maintainer proof policy; PR CI is the proof. There are no human review findings on the original revision.

Exact numstat against the integrated main base: production +228/−139 (net +89), tests +116/−13 (net +103), docs +8/−6 (net +2). The production-LOC exception pays for exact source ranges, YAML value boundaries, and position maintenance that preserves the existing in-memory multiline-value contract; no unrelated cleanup is included. No new detached, background, cleanup, or deferred side effects were introduced.
